source.description: The material to extract from: inline text, or a path/ref to a file. Any kind (prose, notes, spec, code, structured data, prior-stage output).

target_schema.description: Optional downstream contract shape (a JSON Schema object or a flat field list). Present => conform mode; absent => infer mode.

focus.description: Optional steer: what the consuming stage cares about (a goal, a question, or the next stage's name). Steers salience; never invents content.

tier_hint.description: Optional model tier that will consume the contract. Lower tiers get flatter, smaller contracts.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied id, echoed into _meta for trace correlation.
